mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase of 0.5 percentage points or more in the unemployment rate over the prior three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where UNRATE rises > 0.5pp (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month decline of 2% or more in the real sales of domestic product (RSAFS) signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth and compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where RSAFS falls > 2% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise of at least 0.3 percentage points in the unemployment rate and a decline of at least 0.5% in real sales of domestic product over three months signals a synchronized labor-demand shock, which depresses earnings and equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.3pp AND RSAFS falls > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where both UNRATE rises > 0.3pp and RSAFS falls > 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% for two consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary stance, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline of 1% or more in the industrial production index over three consecutive months signals weakening manufacturing activity and reduced corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where INDPRO falls > 1% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase of 0.3 percentage points or more in the unemployment rate over two months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline of 2% or more in the real sales of domestic product (RSAFS) over two consecutive months signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth and compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where RSAFS falls > 2% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).
